title: 'Some account of the natives of Murray's Island in Torres' Straits', from the journal of a naval officer, United Service Journal 1834 pt 2
evidence: 'Camear, father. Coskera, mother. Garri, a woman... Lema, the sun. Meba, the moon. Vera, a star.'
novelty_basis: Web search for the article + Meriam vocabularies: Glottolog's early refs are Jukes 1847 and later; found no citation of this 1834 anonymous list
language_status: well documented today (endangered); early attestations few
notes: Pre-dates Jukes/Fly material by about 10 years. Anonymous author; ship name left blank in print.

title: W. van Hogendorp, 'Description de l'île de Timor' (French trans. by Depping), Annales des voyages t.6, with 'Extrait d'un vocabulaire de la langue de Timor'
modern_id: Uab Meto / Dawan (uabm1237) from the numerals (noua 2, fenou 8? , aima 5)
evidence: 'Un, Deux noua. Trois fenou... Le soleil nenon... La terre nejo... Un Européen kasse mouly'
novelty_basis: Van Hogendorp's Timor description is cited in the ANU Timor bibliography; I found no linguistic citation of its vocabulary. Not checked in Glottolog in detail
notes: Early (1779) Timorese list. Worth checking the Dutch original in Verhandelingen vol. 1.

title: [A. Cheyne?] 'Vocabulary of the Bornabi Language', Nautical Magazine 1848
size: several hundred words and phrases, plus a counting system
evidence: 'Vocabulary of the Bornabi Language. Fdge'tum. What name... Aramas'. Men.'
novelty_basis: Glottolog cites Cheyne 1852, Description of Islands in the Western Pacific (Bornabi = Pohnpeian). This 1848 magazine version is an earlier printing of it

title: 'Vocabulary of the Yap Language' and 'Vocabulary of the Pallou Language', Nautical Magazine 1849
evidence: 'Farape. One. Arou. Two. Thaleip. Three... Vocabulary af the Pallou Language. May. To come.'
novelty_basis: Probably by Cheyne, so likely the same material as his 1852 book (cited in Glottolog). Authorship not confirmed

title: Adam de Bauve & Ferré, 'Voyage dans l'intérieur de la Guyane', Bulletin Soc. Géographie 2e sér. t.1-2
evidence: 'VOCABULAIRE. Noms Ojampis. Tête Eacang... Frère Eroi'
novelty_basis: Wikipedia/Glottolog: first Wayampi wordlist; reprinted in Martius 1867
notes: Listed for completeness and to avoid duplicates.

title: J. Phayre, 'Account of Arakan', JASB 10 (1841), Appendix D (Kyan, Mru and other hill-tribe words)
evidence: 'A few words of their language will be found in Appendix D.'
novelty_basis: Phayre's Arakan material is a standard citation in Kuki-Chin historical literature (from memory, not re-checked)
notes: Appendix itself not opened; only the references to it were verified.
